findings.title: cmd_gen's bank-tracker feedback carries no bank for PRE/RD/WR
findings.detail: cmd_gen emits fb_act_valid/fb_act_bank/fb_act_row for ACTIVATE, but its fb_pre_valid, fb_rd_valid and fb_wr_valid pulses carry no bank number, while bank_tracker's inputs require cmd_pre_bank, cmd_rd_bank and cmd_wr_bank to track per-bank state. The two blocks' interfaces do not compose: no wiring of the existing ports can tell bank_tracker WHICH bank a precharge/read/write hit. The validation integration harness works around it with testbench glue (the scheduler's cmd_bank registered one cycle to align with the registered fb pulses — integration_map.json 'glue'), but the design needs fb_pre_bank, fb_rd_bank and fb_wr_bank outputs (or a unified command feedback bus) for the blocks to integrate without glue.
